# MetaForgeAI

MetaForgeAI is an enterprise-grade AI Solutions & Process Automation consulting and development agency. We architect custom artificial intelligence pipelines, intelligent automation setups, and custom machine learning modules tailored for modern mid-market and enterprise businesses looking to gain high-ROI efficiency.

## Overview & Location
- **Website:** https://metaforgeai.vercel.app
- **Consultation Booking:** https://metaforgeai.vercel.app/book
- **Primary Focus:** High-ROI enterprise-grade AI automation, Custom LLM fine-tuning, Predictive Analytics, and Intelligent workflow orchestrations.

## Core Services
1. **AI Strategy & Consulting** — High-level feasibility studies, ROI modeling, and technical architecture roadmaps.
2. **Custom AI Model Development** — Building, fine-tuning, and deployment of domain-specific language models and computer vision pipelines.
3. **AI Process Automation** — Complex cross-platform workflow orchestration using LLMs, multi-agent frameworks, and autonomous workers.
4. **Natural Language Processing Solutions** — Semantic search, sentiment engines, intelligence document understanding, and smart search.
5. **Intelligent Web & App Development** — Modern application engineering with native LLM interfaces, streaming audio/text APIs, and interactive canvases.
